original_answer_evidence.quote:
**全路径 `hLq` 确实可能取不到。** 取单分量空间 \(X=\{\bot,a,b,c\}\)，令 \(U=V^*=\{a,b,c\}\)。在 \(U\) 上，把 \(\{a,b\}\) 和 \(\{c\}\) 作为两个零距类，类间距离为 \(1\)。令 \(\bot\) 到自身距离为零、到其余点距离为无穷。这满足附件的扩展伪度量公理。

取两个执行一步即终止的节点。输入 \(c\) 走路径 \(p\)，输出 \(c\)；输入 \(a,b\) 走路径 \(q\)，分别输出 \(a,c\)。各节点在其余输入上输出 \(\bot\)。令代理为该网络的读出，目标在 \(U\) 上恒等于 \(c\) 并保持 \(\bot\)。只采样 \(c\)，取 \(\delta_o=\tau=0\)。目标与路径 \(p\) 均可取零矩阵，且 \(c\) 处的共同锚点距离、路径残差和真实误差都是零。因此正文左侧为 \(\{c\}\)，右侧为 \(\{b,c\}\)；取 \(J\) 为单元素集也得到同一包含式。

路径 \(q\) 没有样本，不参与上述并集。但若它有 Lip 系数 \(L\)，将 `IsLipMatrix` 用于输入对 \(a,b\) 就得到
\[
1=d(c_q(a),c_q(b))\le L\,d(a,b)=L\cdot0=0.
\]
在 `ENNReal` 中即使 \(L=\top\)，也有 \(\top\cdot0=0\)。所以这个例子满足正文所需的证书条件，却无法实例化现有全局定理的 `hLq`。

### #h-0056e459b9376864 路径局部经验保证域

设 $q\in\mathcal P$，$j\in I_{\mathrm{res}}(q)$。取路径链的受限 Lip 证书

$$
\mathbf L_q\in\mathscr L(c_q)\big|_{U_q},
$$

并令

$$
\mathbf A_q=\mathbf L_q+\mathbf L^*.
$$

**定义（路径分量经验保证域）**：对有限阈值 $\tau_j\in[0,+\infty)$，定义

$$
U_{q,j}(\tau_j)
=
\{x\in U_q:
D_{\mathbf A_q,j}(x;S_{q,j})+\hat\varepsilon_{q,j}\leq\tau_j\}.
$$

对非空 $J_q\subseteq I_{\mathrm{res}}(q)$ 与阈值族 $\boldsymbol\tau=(\tau_j)_{j\in J_q}$，定义

**推论 #h-93b9c20ea18b4e59（路径保证域的全局拟合含义）**：对任意 $j\in I_{\mathrm{res}}$ 与有限阈值 $\tau_j$，

$$
\bigcup_{\substack{q\in\mathcal P\\ j\in I_{\mathrm{res}}(q)}}U_{q,j}(\tau_j)
\subseteq
\{x\in U:d_j(\phi(x),\phi^\natural(x))\leq\tau_j\}.
$$

更一般地，对给定非空分量族 $J\subseteq I_{\mathrm{res}}$，

$$
\bigcup_{\substack{q\in\mathcal P\\ J\subseteq I_{\mathrm{res}}(q)}}
U_{q,J}(\boldsymbol\tau)
\subseteq
\{x\in U:\forall j\in J,\ d_j(\phi(x),\phi^\natural(x))\leq\tau_j\}.
$$

**证明**：若 $x$ 属于左侧某个路径局部保证域，则由 @h-4b5219aa3a3bbdad 得到对应分量的误差上界。对所有 $j\in J$ 同时应用即可。$\square$

theorem path_component_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq : N.ReachablePath → I → I → ENNReal)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (tau : ENNReal)
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath, N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath,
      IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) (Lq q))
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar) :
    {x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
      j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
      x ∈ path_component_empirical_guarantee_domain d
        (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q j
        (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j) tau}
      ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧ d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau} := by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨q, hj, hxq⟩
  exact ⟨N.path_domain_subset_source hxq.1,
    proxy_path_component_guarantee_error_bound d hd target proxy N sample
      delta_o q Vstar (Lq q) Lstar j tau hrep (hpathV q) (hLq q)
      hLstar hj hxq⟩

/--

theorem path_joint_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq : N.ReachablePath → I → I → ENNReal)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (J : Set I) (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath, N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath,
      IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) (Lq q))
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar) :
    {x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
      J ⊆ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
      x ∈ path_joint_empirical_guarantee_domain d
        (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q J
        (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) tau}
      ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧
        ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau j} := by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨q, hJ, hxq⟩
  refine ⟨N.path_domain_subset_source hxq.1, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have hchain :=
    path_chain_eq_represented_proxy_on_path N proxy q hrep hxq.1
  simpa [hchain] using
    (path_joint_guarantee_error_bound d hd target N sample delta_o q
      Vstar (Lq q) Lstar J tau (hpathV q) (hLq q) hLstar hJ hxq j hj)

/--

theorem path_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq : N.ReachablePath → I → I → ENNReal)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (tau_j : ENNReal)
    (J : Set I) (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hj_evaluable : j ∈ evaluable_components sample)
    (hJ_evaluable : J ⊆ evaluable_components sample)
    (htau_j_finite : finite_ennreal tau_j)
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : ∀ i : I, i ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau i))
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath, N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath,
      IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) (Lq q))
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar) :
    ({x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
        j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
        x ∈ path_component_empirical_guarantee_domain d
          (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q j
          (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j) tau_j}
        ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧
          d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau_j}) ∧
      ({x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
        J ⊆ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
        x ∈ path_joint_empirical_guarantee_domain d
          (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q J
          (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) tau}
        ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧
          ∀ i : I, i ∈ J →
            d i (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau i}) := by
  have _ := hj_evaluable
  have _ := hJ_evaluable
  have _ := htau_j_finite
